# The Hollywood Reporter

> Entertainment industry news, reviews, analysis and awards coverage spanning film, television, business, music and lifestyle.

The Hollywood Reporter is a leading trade publication covering Hollywood and the global entertainment business, with reporting on movies, TV, streaming, awards, executives, creators, celebrities, box office and culture.

## Main Sections
- [Movies](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/movie-news/): Film news, reviews, box office reporting and industry coverage.
- [TV](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-news/): Television and streaming news, reviews, renewals and casting updates.
- [Business](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/business-news/): Media, studios, deals, executives and entertainment business reporting.
- [Awards](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/awards/): Oscars, Emmys, Cannes, festivals and awards-season analysis.
- [Music](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/music/music-news/): Music industry news, charts, artists and live-event coverage.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/lifestyle/): Style, culture, events, travel and luxury coverage.
- [Newsletters](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/newsletters/): Editorial newsletters covering major entertainment beats.
- [Video](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/video/): Interviews, roundtables, clips and original video features.

## Movies
- [Movie News](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/movie-news/): Breaking film news, casting, development and release coverage.
- [Movie Reviews](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/movie-reviews/): Critical reviews of theatrical and streaming film releases.
- [Box Office](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/box-office/): Domestic and international box office analysis and weekend reports.
- [Trailers](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/movie-trailers/): New film trailers and first-look promotional coverage.
- [Movie Features](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/movie-features/): In-depth features, interviews and trend reporting on film.
- [Movie Premiers](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/movies/movie-premieres/): Red carpet and premiere-event coverage for major films.

## Television
- [TV News](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-news/): Breaking television and streaming industry news.
- [TV Reviews](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-reviews/): Reviews of scripted, unscripted and limited television series.
- [TV Features](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-features/): Interviews, explainers and trend pieces on television.
- [TV Recaps](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-recaps/): Episode recaps and analysis for major series.
- [TV Ratings](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-ratings/): Nielsen, streaming and audience-performance reporting.
- [TV Premiere Dates](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/tv/tv-premiere-dates/): Schedules and updates for upcoming television premieres.

## Business
- [Business News](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/business-news/): Studio, network, agency and executive business reporting.
- [Digital](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/digital/): Streaming, platforms, social media and digital media coverage.
- [International](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/international/): Global entertainment markets, companies and cross-border deals.
- [Legal](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/legal/): Lawsuits, labor issues, regulation and legal disputes in entertainment.
- [Media](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/media/): Coverage of publishers, broadcasters and media-company strategy.
- [Heat Vision](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/heat-vision/): THR’s franchise, comics, sci-fi and superhero industry vertical.

## Awards
- [Awards](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/awards/): Awards-season hub for major film and television honors.
- [Oscar](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/awards/award-season/oscar/): Academy Awards news, predictions and campaign coverage.
- [Emmys](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/awards/award-season/emmys/): Emmy nominations, races and television awards analysis.
- [Cannes](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/awards/film-festivals/cannes/): Cannes Film Festival reporting, reviews and market coverage.
- [Golden Globes](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/awards/award-season/golden-globes/): Golden Globes news, winners and industry reaction.
- [Awards Chatter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/awards-chatter/): Interviews and reporting tied to awards contenders and campaigns.

## Music and Lifestyle
- [Music News](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/music/music-news/): Artist, label, touring and music-business reporting.
- [Music Features](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/music/music-features/): Profiles, interviews and trend stories from music.
- [Style](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/lifestyle/style/): Fashion, red carpet and celebrity style coverage.
- [Shopping](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/lifestyle/shopping/): Product guides, retail coverage and editor recommendations.
- [Travel](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/lifestyle/travel/): Travel features, destination coverage and hospitality reporting.
- [Food](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/lifestyle/food/): Restaurant, dining and culinary lifestyle coverage.

## Franchises and Special Coverage
- [Heat Vision](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/heat-vision/): Comics, genre entertainment and franchise-film reporting.
- [Live Feed](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/live-feed/): Television-focused reporting and commentary from THR’s long-running brand.
- [Behind the Screen](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/behind-the-screen/): Craft, production and below-the-line industry coverage.
- [Race](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/race/): Coverage of race, representation and inclusion in entertainment.
- [International](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/business/international/): Global film, TV and media business reporting.
- [The Race](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/the-race/): Awards-season analysis, strategy and contender tracking.

## Video, Podcasts and Newsletters
- [Video](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/video/): Original video interviews, roundtables and event coverage.
- [Podcasts](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/podcasts/): THR podcast lineup covering awards, business and entertainment news.
- [Awards Chatter Podcast](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/awards-chatter/): Long-form interviews with actors, filmmakers and awards contenders.
- [TV's Top 5](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/t/tvs-top-5/): Podcast and reporting focused on television business and creative trends.
- [Newsletters](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/newsletters/): Email briefings and curated editorial updates from THR.
- [Events](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/c/events/): Coverage of THR events, roundtables and industry gatherings.
